Bill.BriefDescription: Providing incentives for converting methane gas to a useable fuel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing incentives for the conversion ofmethane gas to a useable fuel; adding a new section to chapter 82.08RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; creating a new section;providing an effective date; and providing expiration dates.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature seeks to encourage theconversion of methane gas to a useable fuel for use in motor vehicles,the generation of electricity, or other offsite fuel consumption.This conversion provides an alternative use for methane gas projectsand provides environmental benefits because it is a clean burning fuel.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofmachinery and equipment, or to services rendered in respect toconstructing structures, installing, constructing, repairing, cleaning,decorating, altering, or improving of new or existing structures or newor existing machinery and equipment, or to sales of tangible personalproperty that becomes an ingredient or component of new or existing p. 1 SSB 6524structures or new or existing machinery and equipment, if themachinery, equipment, or structure is integral and necessary for theconversion of methane gas to a useable fuel. (2) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to charges madefor labor and services rendered in respect to installing, repairing,cleaning, altering, or improving vehicles including new parts, repairparts, and replacement parts, integral and necessary for the conversionto operate the vehicles on liquid fuel or compressed natural gasconverted from methane gas. (3) A person taking the exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller shall retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection and section 3 of this act. (a) "Machinery and equipment" means industrial fixtures, devices,and support facilities and tangible personal property that becomes aningredient or component thereof, including repair parts and replacementparts that are integral and necessary for the conversion of methane gasinto a useable fuel. (b) "Methane gas" means a renewable, waste, or stranded source ofmethane gas from a landfill, anaerobic digestion system, agriculturalwaste, or sewage system. (c) "Useable fuel" means a liquid or compressed gas that can beused as fuel for a motor vehicle, be used to generate electricity, orbe used as a fuel in other offsite consumption. (5) This section expires July 1, 2009.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of machinery and equipment, or to services rendered in respect toconstructing structures, installing, constructing, repairing, cleaning,decorating, altering, or improving of new or existing structures or newor existing machinery and equipment, or tangible personal property that SSB 6524 p. 2 becomes an ingredient or component of new or existing structures or newor existing machinery and equipment, integral and necessary for theconversion of methane gas to a useable fuel. (2) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to charges made forlabor and services rendered in respect to installing, repairing,cleaning, altering, or improving vehicles including new parts, repairparts, and replacement parts, integral and necessary for the conversionto operate the vehicles on liquid fuel or compressed natural gasconverted from methane gas. (3) The definitions in section 2 of this act apply in this section. (4) This section expires July 1, 2009.
